note: Regional park beside Ogema's recreation grounds (ball diamonds, rinks, rodeo arena, community hall), a short walk from Main Street; heated outdoor swimming pool (rebuilt 2021-22), 9-hole golf. Sites 11-14 are tent-only with power nearby; the four non-power sites are narrow overflow spots. --Claude
